description: This file defines functions to load include patterns from environment variables and to create a scoped Vitest configuration for extension memory tests, finalizing with a default export of the configuration.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns from environment variables or defaults to environment object.

methods.name: export function createExtensionMemoryVitestConfig( createExtensionMemoryVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a scoped Vitest configuration for extension memory tests using include patterns and configuration options.
